name: Matadepera (Spain)
description: Red field with three superimposed crosses throughout, white, red and white, of arms 4/12, 3/12 and 2/12 of the height.
history: The flag was approved on 29 June 1992 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1618 of 13 July 1992; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with three superimposed crosses throughout, white, red and white, with arms respectively 4/12, 3/12 and 2/12 of the height.

features.role: three superimposed crosses throughout, white, red and white
